selection_model.source: deterministic IndexR-score surrogate: Gaussian score + scene pulse, top-k inside candidate window
selection_model.candidate_window: last min(W, num_regions_total-1) historical regions, current region appended by GBSA contract

scenes.recent_contiguous: one contiguous top-k region band near the recent end
scenes.multi_sink: 8 contiguous bands of topk/8 regions evenly spread over the candidate window
scenes.uniform: flat/diffuse score, top-k approximately uniform over the candidate window

timed_scope: aclnn GenericBlockSparseAttention core op only; metadata/prepack/indexer excluded
